title: What Are the Macedonian Wedding Traditions You Did Not Know?
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget

refresh_of.note: Person: original page. Check for legacy slugs that hold rankings; recommend direct 301s at publish.

notes: REFRESH: the brief reads the old page in full with mcp__Apify__apify--web-fetch; SEO pulls its ranked keywords and status and checks weddedwonderland.com for legacy slugs and other ranking pages. Keep its traditions if sourceable; never reuse wording; drop errors; correct brand terms.

Naming, no politics: the country is officially North Macedonia (since 2019). 'Macedonian' here means the customs of ethnic Macedonians, including the Macedonian-Australian community. Do not conflate with Greek Macedonia; no political commentary.

Likely customs (brief finalises): kum and kuma, the formal asking and engagement, the wedding flag, bread and the ritual welcome of the bride, the groom's party collecting the bride, dowry and gifts, wedding music and oro circle dances, the Galicnik Wedding Festival, Orthodox church rites (crowning) only where sourced. UNESCO: Kopachkata (2014), Glasoechko (2015), only where wedding-related. Macedonian diacritics in transliterations where sourced.

Destination angle: Australians marrying in North Macedonia, plus Macedonian-Australian weddings at home. Check Smartraveller's current North Macedonia advice live. Legal steps from official sources only (civil marriage at the registry office; which Australian embassy covers North Macedonia); 'check with the registry office and the embassy, including any fees' where unreadable; 'a fee applies' only if an official source says so; 'as at November 2026'.

Sources: UNESCO, North Macedonia's Ministry of Culture and official tourism site, museums, encyclopaedias, academic sources, the Galicnik festival's official pages. Unsourced becomes 'often told' or is left out.
Images: placeholders only; no AI images of people, cultural dress, ceremonies or places; AI only for neutral still lifes (wedding bread) labelled illustrative pending approval.

Speed: WebFetch cannot reach outside sites; Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO from the start. Fact-check as 2 parallel batches, 15 min HARD, save after every 3 facts, separate scratch folders; no extra sourcing rounds. Google Drive disconnected; Firecrawl out of credits.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.
brand-facts.md 'from first idea to the last dance' line: do not use it in copy (readers flag it as a slogan); use the single point of contact and fee/inclusions-in-writing claims instead.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices; no vendor names; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
